item.title: 3 Dead After Christmas Day Crash in Centre County
item.description: Updated 7:45 p.m. Dec. 26 Three people died and three others were injured in a two-vehicle crash on Christmas Day in Howard Township, according to state police at Rockview. item.title: Three Centre Region Municipalities to Increase Taxes in 2026
item.description: As 2025 comes to an end local municipalities have been finishing up their budget planning and tax rates for 2026. Among the six Centre Region municipalities — State College Borough and College, Ferguson, Halfmoon, Harris and Patton townships — three will have real estate tax increases for 2026. State College's property tax is set to increase by 8.7%, Patton Township's by 11% and Harris Township's by 6.1%. item.description: Penn State interim head coach Terry Smith met with the media on Friday morning to provide final clarification on player availability heading into Saturday's Pinstripe Bowl against Clemson. item.title: Photos: Penn State Beats Clemson in Pinstripe Bowl to Finish 2025 Season
item.description: Penn State (7-6) closed out its 2025 campaign with a 22-10 victory over Clemson (7-6) on Saturday in the Pinstripe Bowl at Yankee Stadium in a game between two teams that fell short of high preseason expectations.
